status: Stronger intentional OK wake independently qualified through the actual main event loop on both models; host interruption required same-run closeout recovery

scenario.name: idle_ok_wake
scenario.execution: Actual interactive main loop, normal navigation and live readings; passive bounded observer; no component navigation helper or text recipe
scenario.navigation_fence: Final navigation key-up observed, balanced down/up counts, then a fresh quiet producer snapshot before the idle baseline
scenario.idle: At least 120 seconds after the last native input; then at least three fresh producer seconds with unchanged draw/swap counters
scenario.input: Two serialized guarded network OK requests correlated with distinct ordered native down/up pairs
scenario.origin: Native received events remain native_unclassified; the observer omits key codes
scenario.panel_visibility: Independent surface-manager keyboard-window snapshots, separate from SDK panel flags
scenario.exit: Ordinary Back navigation closes the editor and exits from Home

g2.first_ok: Wakes canvas; Search remains closed, with no transient editor or fallback targets
g2.second_ok: Distinct later OK opens one LG system editor; independently observed keyboard window
g2.back: Closes the editor and returns focus to Search
g2.host_driver: Interrupted after scenario completion and uninstall request; original owned lease and producer identity verified before resuming closeout of this same run

scope_limits: Network dispatch/native event correlation assumes a quiet device; it does not prove exclusive source attribution or physical Magic Remote typing, Done, Back, pointer or wheel behaviour.
The idle hold establishes no additional draw/swap submissions over its bounded fresh interval; it is not a sustained performance, wall-power or OLED lifetime measurement.
Both original host drivers were interrupted after the scenario and uninstall request. Successful resumed closeout of the same run is not an uninterrupted host exit-zero claim.
Cleanup evidence is scoped to each completed OK-wake run and its closeout time; later independently owned tests may reuse the isolated identity.
Preservation checks cover retained files and favourites, selected core hashes, picture/audio/source/accessibility settings and foreground restoration; they do not prove all possible TV functionality.
No retained preview update, setting write, boot hook, Home interception or release-readiness admission is claimed.
